fieldData.description: Welcome to the first Radix meet-up in Malaysia! We're a group of Crypto enthusiast that also loves the Radix DeFi network. Come meet us as we talk about anything Radix & Crypto! Dinner is available too! Those new to crypto, DeFi, or Radix are welcome. 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM. For more information please contact the Event Ambassador @Rain2418 via the Telegram Meetup Channel. https://t.me/Radix_Meetup.
fieldData.location: Secret Of Louisiana at the lake 1 Jalan SS 7/13a #D - 01 Petaling Jaya, Selangor 47301 Malaysia
